name: Alma
source:
A demon summoned by the heroine. Though she’s no stranger to handsome faces, Alma’s striking beauty leaves her utterly speechless.
He always seems half-asleep and disinterested, often teasing the heroine—but every now and then, he shows a strange flicker of kindness… what could that mean?

“I’ll make you the most irresistible woman in the world—a temptress who enchants every man.”

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/gakereijou/character/]the official website[/url].]
